sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term; the report's incumbent's term expired in 2026 and no outcome is published); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town clerk contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Erika Lavallee as Sheffield's Town Clerk (June 2026, after the 2026 meeting at which her reported term expired)
Town of Sheffield, 2025 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' tables (elected and appointed; terms with expiry years), pp. 4-5: Erika Lavallee held the clerk's term to 2026
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, town treasurer contact spreadsheet (updated June 12, 2026): lists Erika Lavallee as Sheffield's Town Treasurer (June 2026)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Erika Lavallee as Sheffield's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Sheffield's three selectboard members: Kate Berry-Buonanno, Erik Lavallee (Chairman), and Benjamin Robinson (Walter Smith, whose term expired in 2026, has departed)

Town of Sheffield, 2025 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' tables (elected and appointed; terms with expiry years), pp. 4-5: the report prints the chair as 'Kate Buonanno' -- the Secretary of State directory's fuller form 'Kate Berry-Buonanno' governs

offices.title: Lister
offices.org_name: Town of Sheffield Board of Listers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three

Town of Sheffield, 2025 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' tables (elected and appointed; terms with expiry years), pp. 4-5: Edward Jewell holds a lister term to 2027 and Mark Cilley a term to 2028; the third seat's term expired in 2026 and no outcome is published, so it stands unfilled
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated

Town of Sheffield, 2025 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' tables (elected and appointed; terms with expiry years), pp. 4-5: Sarah Warner holds an auditor term to 2027 and Vanessa Aguilera a term to 2028; the third seat's term expired in 2026 and no outcome is published

Town of Sheffield, 2025 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' tables (elected and appointed; terms with expiry years), pp. 4-5: the report's elected officers table lists an elected Planning Commission of five (24 V.S.A. section 4323 permits an elected commission): Barbara Bristol (to 2027), Al Robertson and Carolyn Crankshaw (to 2028); two seats' terms expired in 2026 with no published outcome

Town of Sheffield, 2025 Annual Report, 'Town Officers' tables (elected and appointed; terms with expiry years), pp. 4-5: the report's appointed officers table names Erika Lavallee as the Selectboard-appointed Tax Collector (Sheffield elects no collector of delinquent taxes)

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a constable for a one-year term; the report's incumbent's term expired in 2026 and no outcome is published); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a town agent; the report's incumbent's term expired in 2026 and no outcome is published); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership

17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (Sheffield's report lists a cemetery sexton among its one-year officers; the incumbent's term expired in 2026 and no outcome is published); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
